name: Crate
idea: An isometric parcel whose two walls are built from the letters C and N, with a lid split into four flaps by an X-shaped seam.
why: From a distance it is simply a box in three violets, and up close the box spells CNX, so the parcel and the name are one object.
risks: The see-through letter walls are a lot of detail below 24 px, and some viewers may see the lid seam as a cross on a box, so it should not be enlarged on its own.

colors.name: CNX Violet
colors.use: C wall, primary brand colour, reversed-logo background
